API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APILog and Control ForwardingEc Rule Z Resource Update Self Rule
Ec Rule Z Resource Update Self Rule
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecRules/self/:ruleId

Updates the log and control forwarding rule configuration.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the rule.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
accessControl
string

Access permission available for the current user to the rule.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

id
int32

ID of the rule.

name
string
REQUIRED

Name of the rule.

type
string

Type of the forwarding rule. By default, all traffic forwarding rules are assigned the EC_RDR type.

Possible values: [FIREWALL, DNS, DNAT, SNAT, FORWARDING, INTRUSION_PREVENTION, EC_DNS, EC_RDR, EC_SELF, DNS_RESPONSE]

order
int32

The rule order.

rank
int32

Not applicable to Cloud & Branch Connector.

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
ecGroups
object[]
departments
object[]
groups
object[]
users
object[]
forwardMethod
string

The forwarding method used in the rule, indicating whether the traffic is sent to ZIA, ZPA, directly to the destination (DIRECT), or dropped (DROP).

Possible values: [INVALID, DIRECT, PROXYCHAIN, ZIA, ZPA, ECZPA, ECSELF, DROP]

state
string

Indicates whether the rule is enabled or disabled.

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

description
string

Description of the rule.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule was last modified.

lastModifiedBy
object
srcIps
string[]

The source IP addresses to which the rule applies.

srcIpGroups
object[]
srcIpv6Groups
object[]
destAddresses
string[]

The destination IP addresses to which the rule applies.

destIpCategories
string[]

Not applicable to Cloud & Branch Connector.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, OTHER_ADULT_MATERIAL, ADULT_THEMES, LINGERIE_BIKINI, NUDITY, PORNOGRAPHY, SEXUALITY, ADULT_SEX_EDUCATION, K_12_SEX_EDUCATION, SOCIAL_ADULT, OTHER_THREAT, PHISHING, BOTNET,
